description: Implementation of a semantic cache using Qdrant vector database, including synchronous and asynchronous methods for setting and retrieving cache entries, with collection management and embedding generation.

classes.name: QdrantSemanticCache
classes.description: A cache class that interacts with Qdrant vector database to store and retrieve semantic embeddings and responses, supporting both sync and async operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the cache, manages collection creation or retrieval, sets up HTTP clients, and configures collection parameters.

methods.name: _get_cache_logic
methods.description: Processes cached responses, converting string data into Python objects.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Generates embedding for a prompt and stores the response in Qdrant.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response based on prompt similarity.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a response in Qdrant after embedding generation.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cached response based on prompt similarity.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Runs multiple cache set operations concurrently.
